title: Why Eat Organic Food? - Benefits Of Organic Food
summary: Chiropractor's case for eating organic: more nutrients, better taste, no GMOs, hormones or antibiotics, and protection from pesticide poisons and chronic disease.

assertions.quote: organically grown foods have more nutrients, the vitamins, the minerals and enzymes in the micronutrients
only way to avoid the cocktail of chemical poisons present in the commercially grown foods

verdicts.note: Most conventional produce carries residues well below safety limits, organic food can also carry residues, and washing or peeling reduces some.
By EWG's own USDA tally, almost 60% of conventional Clean Fifteen samples had no detectable residue, so many conventional items carry little or none.

Probabilistic exposure modelling of the top ten pesticides on each Dirty Dozen crop put all 120 estimates below the chronic RfD (only one above 1%), so conventional residues were already negligible and organic produce is not residue-free either (23% positive).

assertions.quote: organically grown food cannot be genetically modified in any way
eggs, and dairy products come from animals that are given no antibiotics or growth hormones
growth hormones are genetically modified and had been directly linked to cancer

verdicts.note: Residues from approved beef implants and rbST are tiny next to natural hormone levels, and no causal link to cancer or early puberty is established.
